lessons.title: 7. GROUP BY & HAVING
lessons.description: Group orders by customer_id and select customer_id and COUNT(*) as order_count where order_count > 1 using HAVING.
lessons.starter_code: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING order_count > 1;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING order_count > 1;
